entities.summary: Joseph Staten Bain Jr. was an American economist associated with the University of California, Berkeley. Bain was designated a Distinguished Fellow by the American Economic Association in 1982. The Association described him as "the undisputed father of modern industrial organization economics.". Joe S. Bain was a performers & entertainers from Washington (1912-07-12, Washington–1991-09-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
